issues.problem: Cloud edges are soft and blurred where the photo's are crisp and granular (a coarse, almost pixel-dither speckle along each stratum edge).
issues.evidence: b_centre close-up: edge transitions span ~10-15 px with a fuzzy fringe; fine (mean |dx|) 0.28 vs omaat_f40 2.22, ink_seated 0.6 vs f13 2.15. Compare the left and right panels of cmp_f40_before_after.png.
issues.fix: In inkPanel, narrow the edge ramp (/0.08 -> /0.03), raise the speckle term (0.10 -> 0.18) and add a sparse 1-px dot term near the edge (hash2 threshold where 0.2 < e < 0.8). Keep the panel at ~1.1 cm/px; if it still blurs under mipmapping, use 2x vertical resolution (strata are horizontal).

issues.problem: Strata are fewer and taller than on the real wall: about 2-3 bands over the visible height vs 5-6 thinner bands in omaat_f40.
issues.evidence: omaat_f40 (160-630, 80-360): bands ~0.15-0.3 m tall, aspect ~8:1; b_centre / b_aft: blobs ~0.4-0.6 m tall, aspect ~3-4:1.
issues.fix: In inkPanel use fbm(x / 1.2 + 40, y / 0.14 + 3, ...) for n (more stretched, thinner bands) and keep the lowY fade.

issues.problem: Carried w18 lows: welcome pane has no glass cue, flat bar nosing, inset-stripe tumbler glints, ash grain contrast / repeat, plain J lav doors, door-1 dark-wood streaks; vertical hairlines at the monument joints on the F front wall (b_centre x~45 and ~615, present before too).
issues.evidence: monuments_w18a/b; renders unchanged in those areas; b_centre before / after.
issues.fix: As w18a/b. The joints could be closed by extending each inkWall 0.003 m past its x0/x1 where a neighbouring monument abuts.

gapWorth03: Crisper, granular edges and thinner strata on the ink print (both cheap edits in inkPanel) would lift the F front wall to ~9; the w18 lows remain the rest of the path to ~8.9 overall.
